Your communication officer stares frustratingly at their blank screen. $fleetName does not answer to any of their hails. text:
Your fleet matches orbit with the dark, monolithic geometry of the Hypercube. The adamantine tesseract hangs suspended against the stars, hairline inlays of brass filigree veining its mirror-polished faces.

An intricate mechanical apparatus spans the surface: an outer brass ring, a sunken obsidian core, lateral sliding facets, and a central grounding pin.

Sensor arrays register shifting harmonics between three distinct physical phenomena: Acoustic Resonance, Luminescence, and Spatial Tension. Attempting to force any channel beyond safe tolerances or discharging an empty reservoir will trigger a catastrophic spatial shear.

You review the degraded audio log recovered from the shattered scavenger frigate drifting nearby:

"...they are bound in a closed ring! Sound feeds Light. Light feeds Gravity. Gravity feeds Sound. If you try to force one channel past three units, it fractures. If you try to siphon from an empty channel, it cavitates and violently backfires!

To open the box, you cannot force one to zero while the others rage. You must bring all three into perfect balance—equal in weight—and only then strike the central pin to drain them into the void! Once all three reach absolute zero... the gateway opens..."

The Hypercube rests in its final, permanently stabilized configuration. The adamantine faces are locked open, revealing the empty, dead containment chamber. The local vacuum is devoid of anomalous resonance or spatial shear. The puzzle has been solved.
